sources.title: Existing authored SF Polo water baseline
sources.use_and_limits: 4 ha managed turf subset, 10 MW average IT, selected HSG B, 86.4 mm comparison rain, original 200 m³ tank and irrigation assumptions. Not measured park performance.

sources.title: Existing authored SF Polo energy baseline
sources.use_and_limits: 10 MW average IT and transferred annual PUE 1.20 yield 105,120 MWh/year. No verified peak or grid capacity; construction inventory incomplete.

sources.title: JRC PVGIS 5.3 fixed-system response for Polo Fields
sources.use_and_limits: 1 kWp crystalline-silicon system, ventilated/free-standing mounting approximation for roof racks, 10° south-facing, 14% input system loss, DEM horizon. Service-selected PVGIS-ERA5 2005–2023; regional reanalysis, not on-roof measurements or a resolution of park fog/trees/building shade. Response metadata confirms peak_power units kW. No batteries or site structural assessment.

sources.title: JRC PVGIS non-interactive API documentation
sources.use_and_limits: Model method. An explicit NSRDB request was rejected by the live 5.3 service, which advertised ERA5/SARAH3; the successful request omitted database selection and its actual ERA5 identity is pinned from response metadata. No NSRDB weather is claimed.

sources.title: DOE FEMP cooling tower management
sources.locator: Make-up balance, concentration ratio and chemistry constraints
sources.use_and_limits: At negligible drift/leaks, make-up = evaporation + blowdown and CoC = make-up/blowdown. CoC is a concentration ratio, not a literal count of loop passes. Higher ratios need suitable water chemistry/treatment; 6 is not confirmed feasible for Polo. Added control/treatment electricity and other water uses are not quantified.

sources.title: USDA NRCS TR-55
sources.use_and_limits: Same inherited volume method and selected HSG B: turf/landscape 61, graded 86, impervious 98; Ia/S 0.2. No flow routing, peak/flood, groundwater recharge, sediment or ecological outcome model.

sources.title: SFPUC stormwater management requirements
sources.use_and_limits: Educational volume results do not establish design compliance or an actual Polo discharge route.

sources.title: SFPUC Hetch Hetchy Power for Developers
sources.use_and_limits: Project service and any solar interconnection still need assessment. A reduction in annual grid import is not proof of reduced required connection capacity or approval.
